readout_other: Trial-by-trial open-ended subjective reports scored by valence (positive/neutral/negative); numeric rating scale (NRS) and PROMIS pain intensity (chronic pain cohort); PANAS-X Sadness subscale and 6-item Hamilton Depression Rating Scale (HDRS-6) (TRD cohort)
direction_notes: Study assessed subjective cognitive-emotional valence and clinical symptom change rather than neurophysiological excitation/inhibition. Active sonication produced more non-neutral (mostly positive-valence) immediate responses than sham, and positive response rate predicted subsequent reductions in pain/depression severity.

exposures.label: LIFU to ACC subregions (sgACC, pgACC, dACC) in chronic pain and treatment-resistant depression cohorts

target.label: anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) subdivisions: subgenual (sgACC), pregenual (pgACC), and dorsal ACC (dACC)

timing.protocol_description: Individual brief stimulation trials ranged 30 seconds to three minutes, delivered over three sequential blocks per session and separated by short pauses (15-60 seconds) for subjective reporting; each treatment session lasted approximately 60 minutes with 39-44 cumulative trial minutes. Within each trial, 30-ms bursts (5 ms on/5 ms off, 50% pulse duty cycle) recurred at intervals of 0.7-1.4 s (burst duty cycle 2-4%), giving an overall duty cycle of 1-2% across the trial.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Here we describe the subjective reports of 36 individuals diagnosed with either chronic pain or major depression who received repeated brief stimulation trials (807 active, 797 sham; duration 30s-3min) spanning the dorsoventral extent of the ACC.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Both studies utilized similar double-blind, randomized, sham-controlled crossover designs involving LIFU stimulation across two designated stimulation visits (Fig. 1).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Sonication was delivered during trials lasting 30 seconds to three minutes with a 650-kHz carrier frequency and estimated peak pressure amplitude of 1.0 MPa following skull attenuation correction.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Sonication was delivered during trials lasting 30 seconds to three minutes with a 650-kHz carrier frequency and estimated peak pressure amplitude of 1.0 MPa following skull attenuation correction.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.isppa_w_cm2: The estimated mechanical index was 1.2, spatial peak pulse-average intensity was 31 W/cm², and spatial-peak temporalaverage intensity was < 720 mW/cm², meeting FDA 510(k) Track 3 guidelines for diagnostic ultrasound and consensus criteria for non-significant-risk transcranial ultrasound [33].
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: Bursts were 30 ms in duration, alternating 5 ms on and 5 ms off (pulse duty cycle 50%).
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: Bursts were 30 ms in duration, alternating 5 ms on and 5 ms off (pulse duty cycle 50%).

flags.reason: Chronic pain cohort was sampled across eight ACC targets (sgACC, pgACC, dACC) and the TRD cohort mainly across three sgACC subregions; pooled into one exposure with combined target terms since acoustic parameters were identical across targets and outcomes are reported per-parcel rather than per-exposure.
PRF (100 Hz) derived directly from the stated on/off sub-pulse durations (5 ms on + 5 ms off = 10 ms period), a period-to-frequency unit conversion rather than independent arithmetic.

The 30-ms burst is treated as the uninterrupted train; bursts recurred every 0.7-1.4 s within a longer 30 s-3 min trial (burst duty cycle 2-4%, overall duty cycle 1-2%), a nested structure described in protocol_description rather than the four numeric fields.
Paper states ISPTA was '< 720 mW/cm2' (an upper bound); recorded as 0.72 W/cm2.

Device manufacturer/model not named in this paper; described only as 'a novel low-intensity transcranial focused ultrasound device' referencing prior publications (Riis et al., IEEE Trans Biomed Eng 2024; Commun Eng 2024).
Study measured subjective cognitive-emotional valence and clinical scores, not a neurophysiological excitatory/inhibitory readout; classified as not_assessed.
